message.content: {"caption":"Diagram comparing four context-management templates for agent timelines: basic causal, reasoning-augmented, sliding context window, and self-context managing.","description":"A multi-panel schematic shows task, action, observation, and memory elements arranged across timeline snapshots. The basic causal template presents a sequential task-action-observation flow, while the reasoning-augmented template inserts “think” steps across three timelines. The sliding context window shows successive snapshots with older content echoed or extracted into memory. The self-context managing template shows several timelines and context operations that preserve, discard, or compress elements, indicated by colored arrows. The legend distinguishes LLM-generated action tokens, environment or masked tokens, task tokens, and memory tokens.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
